reason: The old receipt aggregation mechanism is not promoted into RedCap 1.0. The useful 1.0 requirement is narrower: receipt evidence must remain proof after runtime reality changes and must never be accepted as completion by itself.
kept_for_1_0: Receipts may support proof chains after changed reality exists.
Receipt-only completion is explicitly proof-only and rejected.
Receipt-like evidence cannot complete extract-and-consume loop items without runtime, contract, knowledge, or RedCap command evidence.
not_promoted_for_1_0: Receipt file presence as completion evidence.
Receipt aggregation as the authority that a task is complete.
